name: api-contract-testing
description: Use when reviewing APIs, event payloads, schema evolution and consumer compatibility.
---
# Api Contract Testing
Inventory producers, consumers, versions, auth, idempotency, validation, timeout/retry, rate limits and error schemas. Propose compatibility cases, consumer-driven tests, negative tests and monitoring. Avoid printing secrets or production payloads.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
